standalone: Journeys with Time has its own brand and its own process. It does not inherit from any other show or system.

feeling.core: Awe, with the ground still under your feet.

art_direction.principle: Atmospheric and ethereal, yet graphic. AI makes only the atmosphere; code draws the science as fine burnished-gold line work.
art_direction.atmosphere: veils, haze, mist, void, depth, light passing through darkness; painterly, matte, grain; no objects
art_direction.graphic: crisp thin gold lines (light cone, rings, orbits, spacetime grid, waves, pulse), lots of negative space, no glow
art_direction.style_prompt: atmospheric and ethereal, a vast quiet void, veils of haze and soft mist, depth and distance, deep regal night-purple and aubergine darkness (#150A26), a restrained touch of burnished gold and soft platinum light, painterly fine art, matte, film grain, minimal, lots of empty negative space, no objects, no buildings, no people, no faces, no text, no neon, no glow effects, no bokeh, no sparkles, no glitter, no lens flare, no pink or magenta, no 3D render, vertical 9:16, lower third falling into deep shadow
art_direction.motion_prompt: almost still and atmospheric; mist and veils drift very slowly, light shifts gently, a slow steady camera drift forward; calm, regal, no glow, no sparkle, no flicker, no new objects, no cuts, no text

never_do: neon or saturated pink and magenta
glow treatments, bloom, light leaks, lens flare
photographic objects in a room (hourglasses, clocks, crystals as products)
solid AI-drawn science objects: the science is always drawn in code
copying content from reference images; take only their feeling
text or letters inside generated art

plates.means: time's direction, different views, the present moment
cycles, the disconnection of time, measuring time
light, cosmos, trails of time, energy

plates.note: plate contains neon-coloured bars from its reference; a clean variant is offered
